lessons: a cache whose history changes between fetches cannot be reasoned about from one read; the fetch date belongs beside the figure
the cost of a silent fallback scales with how much news the day carried - the same fault cost nothing on a quiet day and buried a downgrade, a RM4.83bn approval and a +3.95% move on a busy one
a defect that self-heals a day later is the hardest to notice and the easiest to keep shipping, because every retrospective check finds the data correct
